set.bulk.fanoutErrors: The change failed on these servers: {{list}}

set.bulk.issue.apex_cname: A CNAME is not allowed at the zone apex.
set.bulk.issue.apex_ns_delete: The NS records at the zone apex must not be deleted entirely.
set.bulk.issue.class_unsupported: Line {{line}}: only class IN is allowed.

set.bulk.issue.owner_missing: Line {{line}}: the line starts with whitespace but there is no previous name.
set.bulk.issue.scope_invalid: {{name}} {{type}} from the loaded range is invalid and was ignored.
set.bulk.issue.soa_forbidden: SOA cannot be changed or deleted in the bulk editor – please use the single-record editor.
set.bulk.issue.too_many_changes: Too many changes in one request (maximum {{max}} RRsets). Please split it up.
set.bulk.issue.too_many_lines: The text is too long (maximum {{max}} lines).
set.bulk.issue.ttl_conflict: {{name}} {{type}}: different TTLs in the text, {{ttl}} is used.
set.bulk.issue.type_unknown: Record type {{type}} is not allowed here.
set.bulk.issue.value_missing: {{name}} {{type}}: value {{content}} no longer exists. Please reload the zone.
set.bulk.loadAllConfirm: The current text will be replaced by all records of the zone. Continue?
set.bulk.loadedHint: Loaded {{rrsets}} RRsets with {{values}} values. Selected single values are always loaded together with their complete RRset.
set.bulk.modeMergeHelp: Values from the text are added to existing RRsets. Nothing is deleted. The TTL only changes if a line specifies one.
set.bulk.modeReplaceHelp: Every RRset (name + type) that appears in the text is replaced entirely by the lines in the text. Values missing there are deleted. Other RRsets are left untouched.
set.bulk.modeSyncHelp: Like “Replace” – in addition, loaded RRsets whose lines you removed are deleted entirely.
set.bulk.modeSyncUnavailable: Only available after loading records (selection or “Load all records”).
set.bulk.noChanges: No changes – the zone already matches the requested state.
set.bulk.openTextEditorTitle: Paste or edit multiple records in BIND format
set.bulk.parseErrorsTitle: The text contains errors – please fix them:
set.bulk.peerDrift: Some values were already missing on {{servers}} and were skipped there.
set.bulk.ptrDeleteHint: The matching PTR is removed as well if it points to this name.
set.bulk.ptrProblems: PTR maintenance: {{count}} entries with notes – see the history of the reverse zone for details.
set.bulk.removalWarning: Warning: {{values}} existing values will be removed and {{rrsets}} RRsets deleted.
set.bulk.semanticsMergeBanner: Add: values are only added, existing values are kept.
set.bulk.semanticsReplaceBanner: Replace: the RRsets listed below are overwritten entirely. Values that are not in the text are deleted.
set.bulk.semanticsSyncBanner: Edit: the loaded RRsets are replaced by the text. RRsets whose lines were removed are deleted.
set.bulk.soaNotSelectable: SOA can only be changed in the single-record editor
set.bulk.syntaxHelpBody: One line per value: name [TTL] [IN] type content. Names without a trailing dot are relative to the zone, @ is the zone itself. $ORIGIN and $TTL are allowed, comments start with ;. Disabled values start with ;@disabled. TXT strings may be at most 255 characters (split longer ones into several "…" "…"). SOA and DNSSEC records (RRSIG, NSEC, NSEC3) are not allowed.
set.bulk.ttlWholeRrset: In DNS the TTL always applies to the whole RRset (name + type). Affected: {{rrsets}} RRsets with {{values}} values, {{unselected}} of them not selected.
